subject: Human Body
title: Cortisol: The Stress Hormone
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Cortisol: The Stress Hormone.

hook.text: A deadline looms. Your adrenal glands release cortisol, spiking your blood sugar and sharpening your focus.

buildup.text: Cortisol is made by the adrenal cortex.

discovery.text: Cortisol follows a daily rhythm: highest in the morning to wake you up, lowest at night to allow sleep.

climax.text: Short-term cortisol saves you. Long-term cortisol destroys you.

punchline.text: Cortisol is a survival tool that becomes a slow poison.

quiz.question: What does chronic high cortisol cause?
options: Increased muscle mass and bone density
Weight gain, weakened immunity, and brain memory shrinkage
Improved sleep quality and lower blood pressure
